findings.title: The 'still unsettled at 99 ms' assertion in 'preserves cleanup_unproved when fresh verification I/O never settles' is vacuous and the PR body claims it pins the 100 ms budget
findings.evidence: scripts/ovd419-acquisition-preparation.test.mjs:616-617 at 09c0680: `await vi.advanceTimersByTimeAsync(99); expect(settled).toBe(false);`. Coordinator mutant on a throwaway worktree of the head: scripts/ovd419-synthetic-acquisition-reader.mjs:84 changed from `Math.min(remaining, 30000)` to `Math.min(remaining, 30000) - 90` (a 10 ms budget). `NO_COLOR=1 npx vitest run scripts/ovd419-acquisition-preparation.test.mjs -t "preserves cleanup_unproved when fresh verification I/O never settles"` PASSED 3/3 (`Tests 1 passed | 43 skipped (44)`). So the test cannot tell a 10 ms budget from the 100 ms one: after the bounded open rejects, persist cannot settle until the real directory-handle closes (closeOwnedHandle, reader :114, `Promise.resolve().then(() => handle.close())`, real libuv I/O) finish, and advanceTimersByTimeAsync only drains microtasks, so `settled` is false at 99 ms whatever the budget. Only the upper bound (a budget that never fires would hang at `await outcome`) is pinned. The PR body's exact-count list says 'still unsettled at 99 ms, rejected with cleanup_unproved at 100 ms'. The reader was restored and the worktree discarded.
findings.suggested_fix: Same remedy the PR #602 reviewer proposed: make the 99 ms check observe the race rather than persist settling. Option 1 (deterministic, preferred): wrap the root and child directory handles opened through the existing node:fs/promises open mock (paths whose basename is the fixture root or starts with `ovd419-acquisition-`) with a close spy, as the existing 'refuses settlement when directory close crosses the original deadline' test does; assert zero directory closes after advanceTimersByTimeAsync(99) and the expected closes after the final 1 ms (the catch path reaches handle.close() through microtasks only, so an early budget timer shows up at once). Then the 10 ms production mutant (reader :84 `- 90`) must FAIL and the unmodified reader must pass 20/20 under the stall. Option 2 (if option 1 is not possible): remove the 99 ms assertion and the 'still unsettled at 99 ms' claim from the PR body and the Linear comment. Record the production-budget mutant result either way.
